description: Creators only, on their own Piku account (asks them to connect). Page insights for the connected creator's public page over the last 30 days: visits, taps, tap rate (visits with a tap) and Rate requests, each with the change against the 30 days before; each link and widget in page order with the share of visits that saw it and its tap rate; sources; countries; the busiest two hours for taps in the creator's time zone; the Rate path; and the one open suggestion. Counts only, never who. Read only. When Page insights is not open on the account, says so.
name: get_insights
title: Read your page insights
